event_uid.description: Identifier generated by the gateway; retries must reuse it

occurred_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the gateway observed the event, by its clock. For maintenance events, when the window started or ended

temperature_celsius.description: Out-of-range temperature, in Celsius; required for THERMAL_EXCURSION_DETECTED

peak_temperature_celsius.description: Most extreme temperature of the excursion, in Celsius; optional with THERMAL_EXCURSION_NORMALIZED

reading_uid.description: reading_uid of the batch the excursion was detected in, recorded as the triggering reading when that batch is stored

equipment_id.description: Optional; must match the unit the API key is paired with

device_id.description: Optional; must match the device the API key belongs to

origin.description: How the maintenance window was started; required for MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_STARTED

technician_id.description: Technician the maintenance window belongs to, taken from the edge grant; optional

service_request_id.description: Service request the maintenance window belongs to, taken from the edge grant; optional

closure_reason.description: Why the maintenance window ended; required for MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_ENDED

start_event_uid.description: event_uid of the MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_STARTED event that opened the window being ended; optional with MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_ENDED, the unit's active window is ended without it
